note: Calhoun County GA (FIPS 13037) publishes parcels only through the qPublic (Schneider) viewer, behind a Cloudflare challenge with no public ArcGIS REST endpoint. The county ArcGIS hosts gis.calhouncounty.org and gis1.calhouncounty.org serve Calhoun County, ALABAMA (Parcel_Viewer_IPV, ParcelOrthos), not Georgia. Georgia Calhoun parcel files are sold by commercial vendors (Rockford Map, Equator Studios). ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Calhoun GA parcel service.
